name: Love Replica
source:
This is the first title by Garden. Sawato was brought up under the strict martial arts training by his grandfather and has never had a girlfriend. His dream was to have one and he had a revelation one day from a goddess who told him, “if you want to be popular, then you should join a band”. Even though he thought that it seemed too simplistic, he went about recruiting members for the band. One day, a new transfer student arrived in his class. She told him that if he becomes really good, then she’ll let him touch her breasts. Highly motivated by this, he gradually became obsessed with the band activities, making precious memories over the summer.

‘Love replicas’ are cloned humans whose sole purpose is as a vessel for organs required for transfer to people suffering from incurable GODS (genetic deficiency organ dysfunction syndrome). 

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/12/01/december-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是Garden的首部作品。泽人从小在祖父严格的武术训练下长大，从未交过女朋友。他一直梦想谈一次恋爱，直到某天受到女神启示：“想受欢迎，就去组建乐队吧。”尽管他觉得这个理由过于简单，仍开始招募乐队成员。某天，一名转学生来到他的班上。她告诉泽人，只要他变得足够出色，就让他摸自己的胸部。在这份强烈动力的驱使下，他逐渐沉迷于乐队活动，并在夏日里留下珍贵回忆。

“恋爱复制品”是克隆人，唯一用途是为患有不可治愈的GODS（遗传缺陷性器官功能障碍综合征）患者提供移植所需的器官。

[引自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2013/12/01/december-2013-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
